info.title: Cabinet API
info.description: API for Cabinet bookmarks, notes, and saved reading

url.description: Relative Cabinet library URL including its search and filters

baseRevision.description: Revision read by the editor; 0 for a new note

saveId.description: Stable UUID for this save, reused on retries

expectedUserId.description: Account that owns this editor draft

folderId.description: Destination folder for a new note

tags.description: Replaces the note tags when provided

folderId.description: Destination folder; null moves the drawing to Unfiled

tags.description: Replaces the drawing tags when provided

preview.description: Small image of the drawing for cards, as a data URL; an empty string clears it

url.description: URL of the video or media

mediaType.description: Type of media to download (VIDEO, AUDIO)

source.description: Client source used for getting-started progress

contentType.description: Content type declared by the page

clientRequestId.description: Stable request UUID, reused only when retrying the same creation

expectedUserId.description: Account that owns an offline request; reject replay under another session

imageUrl.description: Preview image read from the page by the client, used when the server cannot fetch the page

faviconUrl.description: Favicon read from the page by the client

siteName.description: Site name read from the page by the client

htmlContent.description: Netscape HTML bookmark file content as raw string

ids.description: Array of bookmark IDs in their new order

tags.description: Tags to add to the selected bookmarks

folderId.description: Folder ID; null moves the bookmark to Unsorted

isPinned.description: Keep bookmark pinned above unpinned items

role.description: Role granted to people who join with the link

email.description: Email of an existing Cabinet account
